sources.snippet: SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview is a multimodal language model developed for long-context and agentic workflows. It accepts text and images and generates text for applications that combine document understanding, coding, and interaction with external tools. sources.snippet: There has been plenty of research on looped models, but few open-weight ones are ready for agent workflows. SenseTime's SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview, open-sourced on Oct 30, turns that idea into a deployable multimodal model aimed at long context, document understanding, coding, and tool use. Architecture The model has 32 distinct decoder layers.
